## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused on the related issue.
- [ ] Acceptance criteria are satisfied.
- [ ] I reviewed the diff for unrelated changes and sensitive data.
- [ ] Data remains behind the repository and normalized model boundary.
- [ ] Mock data is clearly identified and is not presented as factual intelligence.
- [ ] Accessibility, empty states, partial data, and errors were considered where relevant.
- [ ] New dependencies are necessary, reviewed, and documented.
- [ ] Comments and documentation match current behavior.
- [ ] Planned behavior is not described as implemented.
